A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same FACT research paper, with 21 complete pages including Appendices A–J. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish that pages 3–21 are identical; opening-page differences are limited to front-matter edits and reflow.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original classification experiments on five datasets, including fairness, worst-class accuracy and average accuracy results in Tables 1–3 and additional plots in Appendices F–G.

after.justification: v2.pdf retains these original experiments and their results in Section 5 and Appendices F–G.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same constrained two-player formulation, multiplicative class-weight updates and classifier training procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Fashion-MNIST, Mini-ImageNet and ImageNet under the same data-augmentation scenarios. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain identical comparator sets: normal cross-entropy, focal loss, performance weighted loss, tilted cross-entropy and GGF-enhanced cross-entropy.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 retains ResNet-50 training without pretrained weights and random resized cropping at eight lower bounds ranging from 0.48 to 1. Preprocessing, training budgets and evaluation metrics are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Figure 3 and Appendices F–G retain the same fairness-over-training analyses and worst-class accuracy breakdowns. No analyses are added, removed or revised.

E5.justification: Tables 2–3 retain means and standard deviations calculated across eight crop lower bounds. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval or significance-testing information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–3 and plotted results in Figures 3–12 are identical, including the reported fairness metrics, worst-class accuracies and average accuracies.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulations, Theorem 1 and its full proof in Appendix A are unchanged. Appendix E also retains identical metric definitions.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about the game formulation, convergence, improved class fairness and worst-class accuracy, and limited impact on average accuracy.

C2.justification: Section 5.2 and Appendix I retain the same fairness–accuracy trade-off interpretation and the limitation that overall accuracy decreases on three of five datasets. Applicability and broader-impact discussions are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendices B–D and H retain identical baseline hyperparameters, preprocessing instructions, FACT settings, hardware and training times. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 28 references are unchanged, including positioning relative to max-min fairness, GGF and specialized fairness losses.

P1.justification: The corresponding-author annotation is corrected and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Removing a stray numeric footnote marker adjusts first-page spacing and moves one unchanged introduction line from page 2 to page 1, with small spacing shifts on page 2. All figures, tables and subsequent pages retain identical appearance.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects the corresponding-author footnote and slightly tidies the opening-page layout. The scientific exposition, proofs, experimental evidence, limitations and reproducibility information are identical, so this cosmetic correction does not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
